_comment: Comprehensive Whiteout Survival database: Furnace 1-30 + FC1-FC5, 8 Alliance Events, SvS Rotation, 27 SSR/SR Heroes (Gen 1-8), Server Seasons Timeline, Research & War Academy (Helios T11), Beast Cage Pets (Gen 1-5), Chief Charms (1-16), Chief Gear (1-11), PvP Meta Guides, and Gift Codes.

furnaceLevels.label: FC 5
furnaceLevels.unlock: FC5 Helios T11 War Academy Gate

allianceEvents.name: Bear Hunt (Alliance Trap)
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Essence Stones, Forgehammers, Construction Speed-ups, Alliance Tokens
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Lead rallies with Jeronimo/Natalia/Hector/Bradley; join rallies using Jessie, Jasser, Seo-yoon, or Reina in Slot 1 for +25–30% rally damage!

allianceEvents.name: Sunfire Castle Battle
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Supreme President Title, State Buffs, Chief Charm Materials, Gems
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Hold the Castle for 3 consecutive hours or accumulate the longest total occupation time across the 6-hour window using timed double-rallies.

allianceEvents.name: Crazy Joe (Bandit Siege)
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Chief Gear Design Plans, Polishing Solution, Hardened Alloy
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Reinforce online alliance members with Infantry/Lancer troops while keeping your own heroes home; Waves 10 and 20 hit the Alliance HQ!

allianceEvents.name: Foundry Battle
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Arsenal Tokens, Mythic Skill Manuals, Essence Stones, Design Plans
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Zero permanent troop losses! Assign dedicated interceptors to Imperial Foundry and Boiler Room at the 15-minute mark.

allianceEvents.name: Canyon Clash (3-Way Alliance War)
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Pet Advancement Manuals, Charm Guides, Essence Stones, Canyon Tokens
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Manage March Fuel carefully! Capture the Frozen Citadel in Phase 3 while keeping two mobile squads guarding Bridge chokepoints.

allianceEvents.name: Frostfire Mine (Solo Instance)
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Charm Designs, Charm Guides, Fire Crystals, Speed-ups
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Take the Left Vein Skill Branch (+Orichalcum from Smelters) and save your 5-minute Vein Burst skill for the Level 23 and 43 Vein Outbursts!

allianceEvents.name: Mercenary Prestige (Phaethon Hunt)
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Fire Crystals, Mythic General Shards, Chief Gear Materials
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Complete all 50 solo mercenary waves first, then call Alliance Boss rallies using Gina in your march to save 20% Chief Stamina.

allianceEvents.name: State of Power (SvS Cross-Server War)
allianceEvents.keyRewards: Supreme President, Jewel Secrets, Lunar Amber, Fire Crystal Shards
allianceEvents.strategyTip: Win the 5-Day Prep Phase so your State attacks the enemy Sunfire Castle; up to 90% of dead SvS troops can be revived in the Enlistment Office.

researchTrees.name: Growth Tree (Research Center)
researchTrees.summary: Always max Tool Enhancement and Research Speed nodes first before pushing high-level Furnace or Battle tech.

researchTrees.name: Economy Tree (Research Center)
keyNodes: Meat / Wood / Coal / Iron Gathering Speed I–VI
researchTrees.summary: Unlock gathering speed nodes to level 4–5 for SvS Day 2 gathering tasks, then pivot all speed-ups into Battle.

researchTrees.name: Battle Tree (Research Center)
researchTrees.summary: Lethality and Health nodes in Tier V–VI require 40+ days per node — save Research Speed-ups and Vice President buffs (+10% speed) before starting.

researchTrees.name: War Academy: Helios T11 Infantry
researchTrees.summary: Unlocks Helios T11 Infantry. Because frontline Infantry absorb 70%+ of battle casualties, 90% of players unlock Helios Infantry first.

researchTrees.name: War Academy: Helios T11 Marksman
researchTrees.summary: Unlocks Helios T11 Marksman — massive Bear Trap and Sunfire rally damage boost after Helios Infantry is completed.

researchTrees.name: War Academy: Helios T11 Lancer
researchTrees.summary: Completes the full T11 Helios trinity for 60/40/0 Infantry-Lancer garrison and canyon formations.

pvpStrategies.title: Bear Hunt Slot-1 Rally Joiner Rule
pvpStrategies.details: When joining an alliance member's rally, ONLY your Slot-1 (Far Left) Hero's top-right Expedition Skill is contributed to the rally (up to 4 joiner skills total). Always join Bear Hunt rallies with Jessie (+25% DMG), Jasser (+25% DMG), Seo-yoon (+25% ATK), Reina (+30% Normal DMG), or Bradley (+25% ATK) in Slot 1 — never join with Molly, Gina, or Blue gathering heroes!

pvpStrategies.title: Sunfire Castle Double-Rally Synchronization
pvpStrategies.details: To dislodge a heavily garrisoned whale in Sunfire Castle or Turrets, two alliance rally leaders call 5-minute rallies offset by their exact march travel times so Rally B impacts 1 second after Rally A. Rally A breaks the defender's troop count; Rally B hits before their allies' reinforcement marches can land.

pvpStrategies.title: Attack vs. Garrison Troop Formations (50/20/30 vs. 60/40/0)
pvpStrategies.details: Standard Rally Attack: 50% Infantry / 20% Lancer / 30% Marksman (maximizes backline Marksman lethality while Infantry holds the frontline). Sunfire Garrison Hold: 60% Infantry / 40% Lancer / 0% Marksman (prevents your garrison from being wiped by enemy Lancers diving the backline). Bear Trap Solo/Join: 10% Infantry / 10% Lancer / 80% Marksman.

pvpStrategies.title: Garrison Hero Swap Trick (Patrick / Sergey)
pvpStrategies.details: Inside Sunfire Castle, the building uses the stats (Chief Gear, Charms, Tech) of the highest-power player inside, OR the appointed Garrison Captain. Have F2P members reinforce with Patrick (+25% HP) or Sergey (-20% DMG Taken) in Slot 1 to give the whale Garrison Leader massive defensive buffs.

ssrHeroes.name: Jeronimo
ssrHeroes.note: Remains the #1 Bear Trap & Sunfire Rally Leader from Gen 1 through Gen 5 thanks to his passive troop ATK/Lethality aura.

ssrHeroes.name: Natalia
ssrHeroes.note: Strong Gen 1–2 offensive Infantry lead whose widget buffs rally attack.

ssrHeroes.name: Molly
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Gen 1–2 Rally Leader (Do NOT use as Slot-1 Joiner)
ssrHeroes.note: Best F2P SSR Lancer through Gen 2; AoE stun in Arena/Exploration and +25% damage proc in Expedition.

ssrHeroes.name: Zinman
ssrHeroes.note: Upgrade his right-side Expedition construction skill early to save millions of Meat/Wood/Iron and days of build time on Furnace 15–30.

ssrHeroes.name: Jessie
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Mandatory Rally Joiner (+25% All Troop Damage)
ssrHeroes.note: Place Jessie in Slot 1 when joining Bear Trap or Sunfire Castle rallies — her Lv.5 top-right Expedition skill grants +25% damage to the entire rally.

ssrHeroes.name: Jasser
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Mandatory Rally Joiner (+25% All Troop Damage) & Research Speed+
ssrHeroes.note: Second mandatory Bear Trap Slot-1 rally joiner (+25% damage) AND grants up to +15% Research Speed passively!

ssrHeroes.name: Seo-yoon
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Mandatory Rally Joiner (+25% All Troop Attack) & Healing Speed+
ssrHeroes.note: Third F2P Bear Trap Slot-1 rally joiner (+25% Attack) for your 3rd march queue.

ssrHeroes.name: Patrick
ssrHeroes.note: Essential Slot-1 joiner when reinforcing Sunfire Castle, Turrets, or Crazy Joe defenses.

ssrHeroes.name: Flint
ssrHeroes.note: Essential F2P Gen 2 Lucky Wheel target; replaces Sergey as your frontline Infantry tank.

ssrHeroes.name: Alonso
ssrHeroes.acquisition: Gen 2 Hall of Hero / General Shards
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Top Arena Carry & Rally Leader (+15% Rally Lethality Widget)
ssrHeroes.note: Dominates Arena and Exploration from Gen 2 to Gen 4 with massive backline AoE burst and healing.

ssrHeroes.name: Philly
ssrHeroes.note: Strong hybrid healer and attack buffer for both Sunfire garrison and rally joining.

ssrHeroes.name: Mia
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Meta Bear Trap Lancer Lead (+15% Rally Attack Widget)
ssrHeroes.note: High-roll RNG multiplier makes Mia a staple in top Bear Hunt damage records even in later generations.

ssrHeroes.name: Logan
ssrHeroes.note: Solid defensive Infantry tank for Sunfire Castle defense holds.

ssrHeroes.name: Greg
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Arena Crowd Control Carry & Rally Joiner (+20% HP)
ssrHeroes.note: Team-wide stun and accuracy disruption in Arena.

ssrHeroes.name: Ahmose
ssrHeroes.note: Massive shield absorption and Infantry lethality scaling for Fire Crystal FC3–FC5 wars.

ssrHeroes.name: Reina
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Elite Rally Joiner (+30% Normal Attack Damage) & Arena Assassin
ssrHeroes.note: Top-tier Gen 4 Lancer; works both as a main march carry and the #1 Slot-1 Bear Trap rally joiner.

ssrHeroes.name: Lynn
ssrHeroes.note: Must-spin Gen 4 Lucky Wheel hero for F2P and low-spenders.

ssrHeroes.name: Hector
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Gen 5–6 Meta Infantry Lead & Bear Carry
ssrHeroes.note: Best F2P Infantry in Whiteout Survival history; massive damage ramp and survivability.

ssrHeroes.name: Norah
ssrHeroes.acquisition: Gen 5 King of Icefield / General Shards
ssrHeroes.note: Strong multi-target Lancer with AoE Expedition damage.

ssrHeroes.name: Gwen
ssrHeroes.bearRole: Top Gen 5 Bear Trap Marksman Lead
ssrHeroes.note: Explosive backline burst in Arena and top Marksman rally leader for Gen 5–6.

ssrHeroes.name: Wu Ming
ssrHeroes.note: Flat damage reduction makes Wu Ming nearly unbreakable in Sunfire Castle holds.

ssrHeroes.name: Renee
ssrHeroes.note: High-value Lucky Wheel Lancer for mid-to-late Fire Crystal servers.

ssrHeroes.name: Wayne
ssrHeroes.note: Replaces Gwen in whale rallies with massive crit lethality scaling.

ssrHeroes.name: Bradley
ssrHeroes.note: Universal S+ Marksman that excels as both a rally leader and a 4-march Bear Hunt joiner.

ssrHeroes.name: Edith
ssrHeroes.note: Pairs with Bradley for dominant Gen 7–8 SvS rallies.

ssrHeroes.name: Gatot
ssrHeroes.note: Massive counter-attack shield and garrison defense aura for FC10 servers.

ssrHeroes.name: Hendrik
ssrHeroes.note: Highest single-target and Bear Trap Marksman burst in Gen 8.
